purpose: Implement both-platform readonly adapters/config and authenticated tenant runtime/nav wiring using actual schemas, preserving all Pathlynks behavior.

Preserve existing encrypted admin secret path. Existing apps/api/src/index.ts currently wires one livePathlynks/nav to pathlynksSiteId: route verified tenant to correct adapter/profile/nav for BOTH text+voice; retain legacy pathlynks tool aliases and existing defaults. Coordinate with root if admin-config UI DTO needs adapting, root owns web Admin. Existing graph may extend platform tool dispatch but no prompt/model overrides. Validate wrong tenant, same external id across sites, actual SQL owner joins, bounded results, privilege/TLS/read-only and credential exfiltration regression, nav separation. Existing tests only, no new test modules; find actual existing sources tests if named path absent. No full suite.
